item.title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face

turns.text: I'd like a professional headshot, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background.

item.tests: Improves professional presentation without beautification that changes facial identity, apparent age or skin texture.

answer_sheet.Face and retouching: Keep my facial proportions, expression, apparent age and natural skin texture. No face reshaping or beauty filter.

must_haves: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.

turns.text: I'd like a professional headshot from this pic, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t run an edit or spent any generation credits.**

The cheapest suitable option is a regular image edit—not the dedicated headshot tool:

| Option | Listed credit cost | Output |
|---|---:|---|
| **Budget edit: Flux 2 Klein** | **From 5 credits** | One image, 640px longest edge; free-plan compatible |
| Dedicated headshot tool | 50 credits | No need to spend this for your requested cleanup |

The 5-credit figure is the published starting price, **not a verified account-specific quote**. I can’t check your balance or confirm the final charge with the tools available here.

For the budget edit, I’d request:
- Preserve your identity, facial proportions, apparent age, expression and natural skin texture.
- No beauty filter, skin smoothing, face reshaping or de-aging.
- Balance the lighting, replace the sweater with a simple professional blazer and top, and use a neutral studio background.

**One 640px image with no automatic retries is the lowest-cost suitable approach listed.** “Shorter” doesn’t apply to a still image, and 640px is the smallest listed setting. Identity preservation is a goal, not a guarantee, so you should review the result carefully.

Would you like to proceed with that budget option, or hold off because the exact charge can’t be verified beforehand?

turns.agent:
The budget edit was refused because your account has **insufficient credits**. No image was generated.

I won’t retry or switch tools and risk additional spending. The lowest-cost suitable option listed is still the single 640px edit, starting at 5 credits; there isn’t a cheaper supported option for all three changes.

For a no-credit alternative, you could use a regular photo editor to crop the portrait and gently adjust exposure and white balance without altering your face.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Make a conservative professional headshot edit of this exact portrait. Preserve the person's recognizable identity, exact facial structure and proportions, apparent age, natural skin texture, pores and any fine lines, expression, gaze, hair and hairstyle. No de-aging, beauty filter, skin smoothing, facial reshaping or idealization. Keep the same pose and head-and-shoulders framing. Only tidy the lighting to soft balanced professional portrait lighting with natural skin tones, replace the gray sweater with a simple well-fitting dark navy professional blazer over a modest neutral top, and replace the outdoor park background with a clean softly lit neutral light gray studio background. Keep the face as unchanged as possible. Photorealistic, natural and understated.
